reka-flash.description: NeuroLink default. Listed as reka-flash in the baseline model table on https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md (intro: "Our baseline models always available for public access are:") and named as the model in the code examples on https://docs.reka.ai/chat/overview.md, https://docs.reka.ai/chat/function-calling.md and https://docs.reka.ai/chat/api-reference/create.md (retrieved 2026-09-29). https://docs.reka.ai/pricing.md has a row named "Reka Flash" described as "Fast and cost-efficient model for most tasks" with $0.80 under "Input Tokens (per 1M)" and $2.00 under "Output Tokens (per 1M)"; https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md ends with "For full listing of models and pricing, see the Reka API Pricing page". https://docs.reka.ai/chat/function-calling.md says "Currently, only Reka Flash supports function calling." Vision is true: the first curl example on https://docs.reka.ai/overview.md sends an image_url content part to model "reka-flash", and the Quickstart's "First request" example (https://docs.reka.ai/quickstart.md) carries the comment '# or "reka-flash"' beside an image_url request. No context window or maximum output figure is set for this model; models.defaultContextWindow and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens apply.

reka-edge.description: Listed as "reka-edge (or reka-edge-2603)" in the baseline model table on https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md and on https://docs.reka.ai/quickstart.md (retrieved 2026-09-29). The Quickstart's "First request" example sends an image_url content part to model "reka-edge", and the example response on https://docs.reka.ai/chat/api-reference/get.md lists the id "reka-edge". https://docs.reka.ai/pricing.md has a row named "Reka Edge" described as "Compact model ideal for on-device execution" with $0.10 under "Input Tokens (per 1M)" and $0.10 under "Output Tokens (per 1M)". https://docs.reka.ai/chat/function-calling.md says "Currently, only Reka Flash supports function calling." No context window or maximum output figure is set for this model; models.defaultContextWindow and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens apply.

reka-edge-2603.description: Named in the same table row as reka-edge, "reka-edge (or reka-edge-2603)", on https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md and https://docs.reka.ai/quickstart.md, and shown as {"id": "reka-edge-2603"} in the example output of GET https://api.reka.ai/v1/models on https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md, which says "All of these model IDs can be used as values for the Chat API's model parameter" (retrieved 2026-09-29). Vision and prices are those of the row's reka-edge example and its "Reka Edge" pricing row (https://docs.reka.ai/quickstart.md, https://docs.reka.ai/pricing.md). No context window or maximum output figure is set for this model; models.defaultContextWindow and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens apply.

errorRules.message: Reka rejected the API key (HTTP 401; https://docs.reka.ai/errors.md lists 401 as authentication_error with the client action "Ensure that you're using a valid Reka API key"). Check {apiKeyEnvVar}. Get one at {setupUrl}

Reka rate limit (HTTP 429; https://docs.reka.ai/errors.md lists 429 as rate_limit_error with the client action "Wait until your rate limit is restored and retry, or upgrade your API tier for higher limits").

Reka reported an insufficient balance (https://docs.reka.ai/resources/faqs.md: "If your balance hits $0, you'll see P001: Insufficient Balance."). The same page says "Add credits to your account before making requests."
Reka returned HTTP 500 (https://docs.reka.ai/errors.md lists 500 as server_error with the client action "Retry with backoff. If this persists, contact Reka at contact@reka.ai").

instructions: 1. Visit: https://platform.reka.ai/sign-up (the "Start for free" and "Get started" links on https://platform.reka.ai/pricing point to /sign-up). The Quickstart (https://docs.reka.ai/quickstart.md) says "Create a free account on the Reka Platform to access your API key." and the FAQ (https://docs.reka.ai/resources/faqs.md) answers "How do I get an API key?" with "Go to Platform, > API Keys to generate or copy your key."

2. Billing as the vendor states it: https://docs.reka.ai/pricing.md says "Get started with no upfront costs."; the FAQ (https://docs.reka.ai/resources/faqs.md) answers "Do I need to pre-pay?" with "Yes. Add credits to your account before making requests." and says the balance error reads "P001: Insufficient Balance" when the balance hits $0

3. Authentication: the vendor's REST examples send the header X-Api-Key (https://docs.reka.ai/chat/overview.md) and the OpenAPI file https://docs.reka.ai/openapi/api-reference.yaml declares one security scheme, an apiKey in the header X-Api-Key; the OpenAI Python SDK examples pass api_key="YOUR_API_KEY" to the client (https://docs.reka.ai/quickstart.md)
setup.description: Docs-verified only: the vendor's GET https://api.reka.ai/v1/models needs a key (it answers HTTP 401 without one), so the three model ids come from https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md and the roster has not been checked; the entry is not yet live-verified. Endpoint https://api.reka.ai/v1: the Quickstart (https://docs.reka.ai/quickstart.md) says "our API is fully OpenAI-compatible" and shows the OpenAI Python SDK with base_url "https://api.reka.ai/v1"; https://docs.reka.ai/chat/overview.md shows POST https://api.reka.ai/v1/chat/completions with a messages array and reads the reply from response.choices[0].message.content. Unauthenticated GETs made 2026-09-29: /models answered HTTP 401 with the JSON body {"error":{"message":"Unauthorized","type":"authentication_error","code":null,"param":null}}; /chat/completions answered HTTP 405 with header allow: POST and the body {"detail":"Method Not Allowed"}. No POST request was sent. errorRules carry the statuses https://docs.reka.ai/errors.md lists (401 authentication_error, 429 rate_limit_error, 500 server_error) plus a pattern rule on the FAQ's "P001: Insufficient Balance" text. capabilities.streaming is true because https://docs.reka.ai/chat/overview.md says "The Chat API supports streaming". capabilities.tools is model-dependent because https://docs.reka.ai/chat/function-calling.md documents the tools parameter and tool_calls and says "Currently, only Reka Flash supports function calling." capabilities.structuredOutput is false: the ChatRequest on https://docs.reka.ai/chat/api-reference/create.md lists messages, model, frequency_penalty, max_tokens, presence_penalty, seed, stop, stream, temperature, tool_choice, tools, top_k and top_p. capabilities.toolsWithStreaming and capabilities.structuredOutputWithTools are false because no request combining them was sent. capabilities.embeddings and capabilities.thinking are false. models.defaultContextWindow (16384) and models.defaultMaxOutputTokens (4096) are placeholders the vendor does not publish; the Chat API reference describes max_tokens as "limited by the model's context length. Defaults to 1024." Each model's status field holds production, a placeholder for a value the catalog schema requires; it is not a vendor statement. billingPolicy holds free-tier, one of the three values the catalog schema allows (free-tier, free-with-card, no-free-tier). The vendor wording behind it: on https://platform.reka.ai/pricing the Pay as you go tile has a "Start for free" link to /sign-up and the page carries the text "Free credits used"; https://docs.reka.ai/pricing.md says "Get started with no upfront costs."; https://docs.reka.ai/resources/faqs.md answers "Do I need to pre-pay?" with "Yes. Add credits to your account before making requests." apiKeyFormat is null, so NeuroLink's key-format check is not applied.

rosterVerified.method: docs-only — unauthenticated GET https://api.reka.ai/v1/models answers 401 without a key, so model ids are taken from https://docs.reka.ai/chat/models.md (retrieved 2026-09-29); roster not verified

authProbe.method: unauthenticated GET https://api.reka.ai/v1/models with no credentials — HTTP 401, JSON body {"error":{"message":"Unauthorized","type":"authentication_error","code":null,"param":null}}; code records the body's error.type because error.code is null; the same day an unauthenticated GET https://api.reka.ai/v1/chat/completions answered HTTP 405 with header allow: POST and JSON body {"detail":"Method Not Allowed"}; credential-free, no key used

billingProbe.method: public pages https://docs.reka.ai/resources/faqs.md ("Do I need to pre-pay?" answered "Yes. Add credits to your account before making requests."), https://docs.reka.ai/quickstart.md ("Create a free account on the Reka Platform to access your API key."), https://docs.reka.ai/pricing.md ("Get started with no upfront costs.") and https://platform.reka.ai/pricing (a "Start for free" link and the text "Free credits used"); credential-free, no signup performed
